source: Intermediate short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: مرة بالسوق، شفت ولد صغير عم يبكي لحاله.
sentences.en: Once at the market, I saw a little boy crying by himself.
I got close to him and asked where his mom was.

sentences.ar: قال إنه ضيع إمه بين الناس.
sentences.en: He said he had lost his mom among the people.

sentences.ar: مسكت إيده وقلتله ما تخاف، رح نلاقيها.
sentences.en: I held his hand and told him not to be scared, we'd find her.

sentences.ar: مشينا بين الدكاكين وسألنا الناس عنها.
sentences.en: We walked among the shops and asked people about her.

sentences.ar: بعد شوي، سمعنا ست عم تنادي عاسم الولد.
sentences.en: After a while, we heard a woman calling the boy's name.
The boy ran to her and hugged her.
His mom thanked me a lot and her eyes teared up.
I walked away from there with a happy heart.
